result.title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
result.summary: As publications and products on time series forecasting (TSF) proliferate, researchers face a growing burden of analyzing existing work. First, not all publications release code. For instance, only about 20% of arXiv TSF papers have a code link in the surveyed period. Second, released code also requires manual maintenance. Thus, TSF researchers must constantly adapt or implement existing works. However, independent implementations can differ in experimental settings and are difficult to maintain. We therefore propose to use AI agents for benchmarking TSF research and even supporting autoresearch, e.g., developing new TSF models. Yet directly applying existing coding agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, is suboptimal: prohibitive costs, limited scalability to large research projects (e.g., benchmarking), and lack of self-maintenance. To address these challenges, we propose TSFLab, a self-improving agent-agnostic "workbench" that equips compatible coding agents with shared resources and tools for low-cost TSF research and continuous maintenance of research resources. Our experiments cover reproduction, benchmarking, and new method development. In reproduction and benchmarking, TSFLab improves task completion by 20-163% and cuts fresh tokens per completed task by 11-66% across baselines. A pilot study of agent-driven method development also shows improved forecasting accuracy via TSFLab, with 32.8-73.6% fewer fresh tokens and 9.2-68.8% less development time than the other settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TSFLab：一个与具体编码智能体解耦的「工作台」，为 Claude Code、Codex 等提供共享资源与工具，用于时序预测论文的复现、基准测试和方法开发，并降低 token 成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属时序预测领域的智能体辅助研究与基准工程，关注复现成本与资源维护，未涉及视觉/多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选或 latent 生成，其 token 指标也只服务研究自动化，故缺少实质联系。
